computers.title: Computers
computers.description: Daemon onboarding, reconnect commands, detected runtimes, and agent workspace status.

onboarding.reconnectDesc: This computer is already installed and set up. It only needs to reconnect.
onboarding.installGuideWindows: Press Win + X and choose Terminal, or search for PowerShell in the Start menu; paste and press Enter.
onboarding.installGuideUnix: Open Terminal, paste the command, and press Enter.
onboarding.installExpect: Done when the installer prints the installed version; failures explain the reason and can be retried.
onboarding.setupGuide: Run it in the same window. It only writes local config and identity — it does not connect yet.
onboarding.setupExpect: Done when it prints the machine ID and config path; safe to run again.
onboarding.connectGuide: Generate a one-time connect command below (valid for 5 minutes once generated).
onboarding.connectExpect: After you run it, the status below shows connected within seconds.
onboarding.expiredNotice: The command expired. Regenerate it — no need to redo install or setup.
onboarding.statusIdle: Connection results appear here once you run the commands.
onboarding.pendingHint: Waiting for {name}… usually connects within seconds after the command runs.
onboarding.timeoutHint: Check the command ran on the target computer, the network is reachable, and no permission prompt blocked it — then regenerate and retry.
onboarding.conflictActive: This computer has an active connection. Stop it first, or retry later.
onboarding.windowsUnavailable: The Windows installer is temporarily unavailable. Retry later, or switch to macOS / Linux.
